integrity: Arithmetic classification validated by a standalone exact checker reconstructing geometric divisor classes. Geometric classification is supported by cited primary literature, and this work does not claim novel geometric counts.
scientific_limitations: Valid for a ground-field seven-point blowdown and odd characteristic; not a classification of all W(E7) Frobenius classes or all unmarked degree-two del Pezzo surfaces. Conic pencils are geometric fibre divisor classes. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
title: One-field bitangent and conic-bundle reconstruction for seven-point del Pezzo blowups
